name: worker-fleet
description: Supervisor-side loops that run development through Claude worker sessions. issue-to-review-ready takes one Ready issue from the project board, moves it to In progress before touching anything, stands up a worker in its own worktree, runs openspec-workflow, confirms the draft PR exists rather than trusting the report, hands the review to codex-draft-review, verifies the undraft and reviewer assignment, advances the board, and moves to the next issue — and if it stops anywhere, it puts the status back, because an issue parked in In progress is worse than an untouched one. worker-fleet-loop adds the parallel case: one tick sweeps every worker, answering approvals (everything except merge), nudging the silent, and dispatching one new lane into free capacity measured fresh each tick. The implementation belongs to openspec-workflow and the review to pr-loop; this plugin owns the lane.
